latestVersion.changelog: v0.2.0: Add scripts/extract.py - the canonical AI-agent workflow shortcut. Instead of piping get.py | clean-text-toolkit/htmlstrip.py, one command fetches a URL and immediately extracts: --mode text (plain readable text), --mode title (just the page title), --mode meta (JSON with title + meta tags + canonical), --mode links (anchor href + visible text, TSV or --json), --mode images (src + alt), --mode tables (JSON array of table cell data), --mode raw (raw HTML). --absolute-urls rewrites relative paths to absolute using the response URL as base. All in pure Python stdlib using html.parser. No BeautifulSoup. Same safe-path and exit-code contract.
